planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the 7 available and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load pedagogical facet. To ensure 'HARD' difficulty, the facets were chosen to require deep analysis, edge-case handling, or complex tracing rather than simple recall. Specifically: 1) Binary Search Partitioning Strategy was assessed via MISCONCEPTION_TARGETING to test understanding of the invariant logic; 2) Partition Boundary Properties via BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE to test handling of empty partitions; 3) Median Calculation Logic via OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS to test integer division and index alignment; 4) Cross-Array Comparison Conditions via ERROR_DIAGNOSIS to test invariant violation detection; 5) Pointer Adjustment and Search Direction via OUTPUT_PREDICTION to test complex state tracing.
